items.title: How Far Could Take-Two Stock Fall In A Market Shock, With Grand Theft Auto VI Still To Come?
items.summary: Take-Two Interactive Software (TTWO) stock is down 13.4% over the past month, though still up 3.1% over three months. Over the past twelve months it has lost 12.5% while the S&P 500 returned 17.9%. The weakness is not the market's, and the doubt concerns one game, Grand Theft Auto VI, due on November 19.
